title: Linkage Lab — Mechanism Studio
description: Bolt bars to a bench, spin a crank, and watch a pen welded to the coupler draw the curve only that machine can draw.
concept: A planar linkage workbench: drop joints, link them with rigid bars, ground a pivot, promote a bar to a driven crank, then weld coupler points onto any bar and pin pens to them. A position-based constraint solver runs the kinematics every frame, rockers that cannot complete a turn reverse themselves at their limits, and five classic mechanisms — four-bar, Hoeken, Chebyshev, Peaucellier and a drag-link — load as starting points. Traced curves export as SVG or PNG, whole rigs export as JSON or a share link.
features: Eight build tools: move, joint, bar, ground, crank, coupler weld, tracer pen, erase
Five classic mechanism presets plus a blank bench, each auto-framed to its own swept envelope
Gauss-Seidel distance-constraint solver with adjustable iteration count and a live fit readout
Auto-reversing driver so rockers and double-rockers animate without exploding
Angle scrub, speed control, onion-skin ghosts and branch flipping
Export traced curves as SVG or PNG, rigs as JSON, or copy a self-contained share link
localStorage autosave restores the bench you left behind

interaction.mouse: Drag joints with Move, drag empty bench to pan, wheel to zoom, double-click to refit the view
interaction.click: Each tool acts on tap — joints, bars, grounds, cranks, coupler welds, pens, erase
interaction.touch: One finger builds and drags, two fingers pinch-zoom and pan, tool chips scroll along the bottom
interaction.keyboard: 1–8 pick tools, space plays/pauses, f flips the assembly branch, c clears traces, Delete removes the selection
